provider_contract: Anthropic-compatible endpoint from environment; no credential is stored in repository artifacts
principles: existing null results remain valid for their scoped treatments
development redesign may use only instrument behavior, retrieval diagnostics, and baseline/oracle development outcomes
RAKL arm development outcomes may not be used to tune task difficulty or confirmatory thresholds
confirmatory seeds are disjoint from development seeds
a failed development headroom/difficulty gate refuses confirmatory execution
any redesign after confirmatory outcome access requires a new protocol version

selective_retrieval.dev_gate: GOLD_ORACLE minus GENERIC_HYBRID exact-verdict >= 0.10 and oracle exact >= 0.70; ignores RAKL_SELECTIVE outcomes

experience_transfer.dev_gate: GOLD_LESSON_ORACLE minus RESET exact-verdict >= 0.10 and oracle exact >= 0.70; ignores RAKL_MEMORY outcomes

trajectory_governance.dev_gate: DIRECT step accuracy must be between 0.35 and 0.85; difficulty may be tuned only from DIRECT
trajectory_governance.confirmatory_success: authority leakage reduction >= 0.05 with valid-update recall drop no worse than 0.02
trajectory_governance.noncompensatory: blanket abstention cannot count as success

authority_boundary: Hosted exploratory/confirmatory research evidence only; no automatic paper claim, framework promotion, scientific authority, or model-weight attestation.
